reasoningChain.evidence: I want to recover from the prison loss and prepare the active team for further progress.
The prison defeated the whole squad and the barricade militia has repeatedly appeared very weak.
A rare leg armor item is available and shows a larger fit gain than the common leg armor.
I can equip the rare armor on the active barricade militia at no visible cost.
Strengthening a weak active member with the rarer item is more useful now than equipping an inactive hero.
